places.name: Archon

why.founding: A deep, sheltered estuary mouth on the Padomaic was the one place on this coast a foreign hull could lie safely, so the Second Empire and then the East Empire Company built a stone quay here. The Saxhleel town grew landward of it.
why.siteAdvantages: Estuary with a landable stone shore, a river road into the interior, and the only stretch of the east coast where the mangrove wall breaks for more than a kilometre.
why.occupantsMotive: An Argonian-majority harbour population who work the water as amphibians and run the port authority out of dead Company offices, alongside state customs and a long-settled Dunmer merchant minority from the Morrowind trade.
why.pressures: The lawful port is the province's only functioning customs choke, so everything that wants to avoid it goes round it: half-chartered hulls land on the Oliis shore and wreckers work the Padomaic beaches south of the city. The mangrove behind the city is D4 within a kilometre of the gate. Nobody in the harbour authority will discuss the sealed Shadowscale sanctuary.
why.wouldChangeIf: If the Archon-Lilmoth-Soulrest-Tear line stopped running, or if the harbour authority lost its claim to the Company buildings, Archon would become a large fishing town in a month.
